title: Tens and Units (Place Value)
seo_title: Tens and Units – Primary 1 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Identify tens and units in numbers up to 99; use bundles and blocks; write numbers as tens and units. (summary of the NERDC Primary 1 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 1 maths worksheets on place value: tens and units with blocks and bundles of sticks, teen numbers, digits and decades. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Tens on the left, units on the right
body_html:
How to think about it

  • 10 units make 1 ten.
  • In 34, the 3 means 3 tens (30) and the 4 means 4 units.
  • Teen numbers have 1 ten: 16 = 1 ten and 6 units.

Examples

Example

5 tens and 2 units

50 + 2

Answer: 52

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Mixing up the digitsThe tens digit is first.
Writing 502 for 5 tens and 2 unitsIt is 52.
Counting blocks one by oneCount the tens first.
